key_insight: Subspace Tuning (SST) reduces catastrophic forgetting by restricting fine-tuning updates to the bottom singular subspace, preserving principal weight directions while maintaining strong task learning.
engineering_relevance: SST offers a practical drop-in fine-tuning strategy for LLMs that improves retention, lowers KL drift, and better supports continual adaptation without major architectural changes.
method: Project each weight update into the bottom singular subspace to block changes along dominant directions.
Combine with standard fine-tuning objectives such as SFT and self-distillation; optimizer-agnostic.
Use dense gradient estimation plus a refresh mechanism to keep the protected subspace current.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that protecting up to 99% of the weight subspace improves retention while preserving target-task performance, and reduces KL drift by about 2–4× versus baseline recipes.
watch_item: Computing and refreshing singular subspaces may add implementation overhead and could be sensitive to how often the protected basis is updated.
paper_title: Towards Continual Learning: Mitigating Forgetting With Subspace Tuning
